title: Classic Paintings Resourcepack
description: The resourcepack portion of my datapack to add 60 new classic paintings into Minecraft.
body:
This Resourcepack is pretty self-explanatory, once installed you will have 60 _new_ (not replacement) custom paintings that you can place around in your minecraft world!
All of these paintings are historical paintings (mostly art from the [symbolic movement](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symbolism_(movement)), but there are others too) under Creative Commons! Since all I've done is rescale, tweak, and frame these pieces to work in minecraft, this datapack is completely free to remix, re-use, and repackage for your own needs. If you do so, credit is appreciated, but by no means required! I hope you enjoy filling your world with more beautiful art!</br>
# REQUIRES DATAPACK:
https://modrinth.com/datapack/classical-paintings
